subject: general
question: What was the budget allocation for the Ministry of Rural Development for the fiscal year 2023-24?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,59,964 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The budget allocation for the Ministry of Rural Development for the fiscal year 2023-24 was **₹1,59,964 crore**.
 
• This allocation was aimed at improving rural infrastructure, livelihood creation, and poverty alleviation in rural areas.
 
• Key schemes under the Ministry of Rural Development include **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**, Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), and National Social Assistance Programme.
 
• The increased funding reflects the government's emphasis on strengthening rural development programs to ensure sustainable growth.
 
• It supports initiatives aimed at bridging the urban-rural divide and enhancing the quality of life in rural regions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**

 
 
• MGNREGA is a flagship rural employment scheme that guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households.
 
• It focuses on creating durable assets such as roads, water conservation structures, and irrigation facilities.
 
• The scheme plays a crucial role in poverty alleviation and empowering rural communities.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)**
 
 
• PMGSY aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to unconnected villages in India.
 
• The scheme is instrumental in improving access to markets, healthcare, and education in rural areas.
 
• It contributes significantly to rural infrastructure development and economic growth.
 
 
 
• **National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)**
 
 
• NSAP provides financial assistance to the elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities in the form of pensions.
 
• The program is a part of India's social safety net for vulnerable sections of society.
 
• It aims to ensure minimum income support and dignity for marginalized individuals.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Rural Development**
 
 
• Rural development is crucial for reducing poverty and unemployment in rural areas.
 
• Investments in rural infrastructure, education, and healthcare help bridge the urban-rural divide.
 
• It fosters sustainable economic growth and improves the quality of life for the rural population.
